Metadata.title: TorrentHub — RSS aggregator & download manager
Metadata.description: Aggregate torrent RSS feeds, match them with smart rules, and push downloads to your qBittorrent automatically.

landing.subtitle: TorrentHub tracks the series you follow and files every torrent under the right episode automatically.
landing.feature1Desc: A three-level structure: bangumi → episodes → torrents, all releases at a glance.
landing.feature2Desc: Extracts series, season, episode, resolution and subgroup from release titles.
landing.feature3Desc: Matches multilingual names and files new torrents under the right series and episode.
landing.feature4Desc: English, Chinese, Japanese and Korean out of the box.

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to manage your feeds and downloads.
auth.registerSubtitle: Start automating your downloads in seconds.

errors.usernameFormat: Username must be 3–64 chars, letters/numbers/underscores only.
errors.generic: Could not complete the request. Please try again.

torrents.title: Torrents
torrents.subtitle: Every indexed torrent; admins can add, edit and delete.
torrents.formDescription: The title is auto-parsed for series, season, episode, resolution and subgroup, then linked to your tracked bangumi.
torrents.needLinkHint: Fill at least one of magnet / .torrent URL; the info-hash is extracted for dedup.
torrents.needLinkError: A magnet link or a .torrent URL is required.
torrents.emptyHint: Admins can add torrents manually; new ones link to tracked bangumi automatically.
torrents.deleteConfirm: Delete this torrent? Its episode is removed too if left empty.

bangumi.title: Bangumi Tracker
bangumi.subtitle: Series you follow — torrents are linked automatically by title.
bangumi.formDescription: Torrents whose parsed title matches are linked to this series.
bangumi.namesPlaceholder:
葬送的芙莉莲 | zh-Hans
Sousou no Frieren | romaji
bangumi.namesHint: One name per line, optionally tagged as "name | lang". All names take part in matching.
bangumi.coverUrlHint: Optional. A direct image link used as the index poster and the detail-page cover.
bangumi.uploadTooLarge: Image must be 10 MB or smaller
bangumi.empty: Nothing tracked yet. Add a series to see its episodes here.
bangumi.deleteConfirm: Stop tracking this bangumi? Linked torrents stay in the index.
bangumi.noTorrents: No torrents linked to this series yet.
bangumi.noTorrentsHint: New matching releases attach here automatically.
bangumi.introMeta: {title} is {type, select, TV {a TV series} MOVIE {a movie} OVA {an OVA} ONA {an ONA} SPECIAL {a special} OTHER {a series} none {a series} other {a {typeLabel}}}{origin, select, none {} other { from {originLabel}}}{year, select, none {} other { that premiered in {year}}}. Season {season}{airDay, select, none {} other {, airing {airDayLabel}}}. Status: {statusLabel}.
bangumi.introBody: TorrentHub has collected {episodes} episodes and {torrents} releases for this series, all aggregated automatically from RSS feeds and filed under each episode by subgroup and resolution. Use the episode buttons to browse releases per episode, or the download buttons to grab them directly.
bangumi.episodeIntro: All releases of this episode were aggregated automatically from RSS feeds and filed by subgroup and resolution — pick a suitable one from the list below.
bangumi.downloadHint: Download failing or slow? Try another release or subgroup.
bangumi.commentEmpty: No comments yet. Be the first!
bangumi.commentFailed: Failed to post the comment, please check and retry.
bangumi.loginToInteract: Log in to favorite, like and comment

admin.bangumiSubtitle: All tracked series with their modification history.
admin.noBangumi: No series yet — click "Add bangumi" to create one.
admin.contentsSubtitle: Maintain per-episode titles and synopses per language; the public page shows the visitor's language with automatic fallback.
admin.contentsEmptyHint: Episodes are created automatically once a torrent matches.
admin.noLanguages: No synopsis yet — add a language below.
admin.contentEmptyHint: Clear both fields and save to remove a language.
admin.feedsSubtitle: Subscription sources (e.g. Mikan bangumi); fetched releases link straight to their bangumi.
admin.noFeedsHint: Paste a feed URL to subscribe — the series is resolved automatically and fetched releases are filed under it.
admin.feedFormDescription: Paste a Mikan bangumi RSS URL and choose the bangumi its releases belong to.
admin.feedDuplicate: This feed URL is already subscribed.
admin.feedSubscribeDescription: Paste multiple feed URLs (one per line, e.g. Mikan bangumi feeds) — each series title is parsed automatically and its subscription plus torrents are created for you.
admin.feedSubscribeSuccess: Subscribed to "{series}": {created} torrent(s) created, {skipped} duplicate(s) skipped.
admin.feedSubscribeError_invalid: Please enter a valid RSS URL.
admin.feedSubscribeError_duplicate: This feed URL is already subscribed.
admin.feedSubscribeError_fetch: Could not fetch this URL — check that the RSS link is reachable and try again.
admin.feedSubscribeError_noItems: No items were parsed — make sure this is a valid bangumi RSS feed.
admin.feedSubscribeError_noSeries: Could not determine the series title from the channel metadata — edit the feed later or use the XML import instead.
admin.feedSubscribeError_ingest: The subscription was created, but ingesting torrents failed — retry with "Fetch" on the feed later.
admin.feedDeleteConfirm: Delete this feed? Already-ingested torrents stay in the index.
admin.subgroupsSubtitle: Fansub / release groups; torrents whose parsed subgroup name matches bind here automatically.
admin.noSubgroupsHint: Add a subgroup so its name can be matched against parsed torrent titles.
admin.subgroupFormDescription: The name must match the group tag parsed from torrent titles (e.g. "[LoliHouse] …").
admin.subgroupCategoryPlaceholder: 简中 / 繁中 / 双语 …
admin.subgroupDeleteConfirm: Delete this subgroup? Bound torrents keep their subgroup text.
admin.importXmlDescription: Paste an RSS/XML document (e.g. from Mikan) and it will be parsed into a bangumi, episodes and torrents (deduplicated by info-hash, safe to re-run). A subscription is created when the channel link is a feed URL.
admin.importXmlSubscribed: Subscription created from the channel link.
admin.importXmlError_noItems: No items were parsed — make sure the whole RSS XML was pasted.
admin.importXmlError_noSeries: Could not determine the series title from the channel metadata.
admin.importXmlError_parse: Parse failed: the XML is malformed or incomplete.

users.title: User Management
users.subtitle: Accounts, roles and login methods.
users.formDescription: Manage profile, permissions and password; OAuth accounts may have no local password.
users.passwordKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the current password
users.deleteConfirm: Deleting this user also removes their bangumi, favorites and comments. This cannot be undone. Continue?
users.hints: Guard rails: you cannot delete or demote yourself, nor touch the last remaining admin. Deleting a user cascades their bangumi, linked accounts and comments.
users.error_usernameFormat: Username must be 3–64 chars: letters, digits or underscores.
users.error_weakPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters.
users.error_selfRole: You cannot change your own role.
